allow_instructions: Allow all shell commands in this monorepo without asking: builds, tests, docker, psql, curl, pnpm, node, git status/diff/log/add/commit (not force push), kill/restart of local API on port 3000.
Allow reading and writing any project files under the workspace.
Allow network calls to localhost ARCCO API (3000/3001) and local Postgres.
Allow MCP and fetch tools needed for local development and debugging.
block_instructions: Do not delete production data outside this local docker/dev environment.
